The cards in your hand are first placed in the center of the table to later be collected by you or your opponent. You will also need a good sense of timing: which cards do you put down and in which order? When do you get cards back? There is always a palpable tension during each game, since players are able to win immediately by collecting the 3 City cards ! District Noir is also a game of risk-taking and bluffing. Besides making the right choices, you have to push your opponent into making bad ones. Number of players: 2 Game duration: 4 mn Complexity: 2 / 5 Play District Noir and 1414 other games online. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Contents 2 Setup 3 Objective 4 Each turn 4.1 Rounds 5 Scoring Contents -3 City cards -5 "5" cards -6 "6" cards -7 "7" cards -8 "8" cards -7 plus points cards -9 minus points cards Setup 45 cards are shuffled and 3 removed from the game at random. 5 cards are dealt to each player as a starting hand, and 2 cards face up to the table row. Objective Have the highest score from Influence cards after 4 rounds or collect 3 City cards for an Instant Win. Each turn On your turn you must either: - Play a card from your hand (if you have any left) to the end of the row. OR - Take five cards from the right hand end of the row. You may only choose the take action once per round. Cards taken will count for scoring. (If there are fewer than five cards in the row, you take all of them.) Rounds Rounds end after 6 turns, when each player's hand will have become empty and each player will have taken their draw action. Players are dealt new hands of 5 cards, and the starting player is passed on for the next round. The row of cards remains as it was. After the fourth round, the game ends. Scoring If a player ever takes 3 City cards, they win instantly. Otherwise the game is scored at the end as follows: - Whoever took a majority of 8 Supporters scores 8 points. - Whoever took a majority of 7 Supporters scores 7 points. - Whoever took a majority of 6 Supporters scores 6 points. - Whoever took a majority of 5 Supporters scores 5 points. - Each set of 5-6-7-8 scores 5 points. - Alliance and Betrayal cards score their face value. If tied for a type of Supporter, neither player scores it. City cards are worth no points. If tied on most points then the player with the most eights win. If still tied the player with the most sevens wins. If still tied the player with the most sixes win. If still tied the player with the most fives wins. If still tied, the player with the most city cards win. If still tied it's a shared victory. [Rating: 1/10] Unfortunately, the person responsible for the French translation found it relevant to use the female grammatical gender throughout the entire rulebook (imagine the equivalent of each occurrence of the word “player” being replaced by “female player”), in some misguided attempt to correct what they probably conceive as thousands of years of male oppression or what not. When buying a board game, I expect it to be written in normal French, not in some artificial experiment catering to far left leanings. This is unheard of!

[Rating: 2/10] Rarely have had any less fun in a card game. Koryo is 100x better in the same genre.
